headline: Today's top AI story: Anthropic Commits At Least 5% of Shares to New Public Benefit Fund
bullets: Anthropic Commits At Least 5% of Shares to New Public Benefit Fund
Conducting The First Live Enterprise Comparison Between Agents and Human Professionals
Hackers exploit SiteGuard WAF flaw to run commands as admins
Anthropic says it's committing 5% of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund, for a total of ~20% with co-founder and staff pledges, plus 2% per 50% valuation rise (Anthropic)
